javac -cp "D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\lib\*;D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\WEB-INF\lib\*" -d D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\WEB-INF\classes D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\src\*.java




javac -cp "D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\lib\*;                    ----------->    it acces all bin files





javac -cp "D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\WEB-INF\lib\*"     --------------------->    it help to acces server  bin





 -d D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\WEB-INF\classes     ---------------------->   it help to add all .class files in class folder
 
 
 
 
 
 D:\apache-tomcat-9.0.120\webapps\StudentManagement\src\*.java   ----------------------->   it help to make  all classes files filename.class
